svg.text: Print a post 16 x 16 mm and 64 mm tall with a 4.5 mm hole down

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its centre, counterbored 8 mm from the top for the screw head.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one M4 screw down through the post into the tapped hole in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cap plate, 54 mm from the shaft centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue the Hall switch (12 x 12 x 5 mm) on top, sensing face up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Its face sits 4 mm under the turntable disc, under the magnet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: when the yoke points at azimuth zero.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Run its lead down the post with the motor lead.
